motion.line_reveal: SplitText lines from translateY 39-67px, transform 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.625, 0.05, 0, 1)

taste.name: Rows, not cards
taste.trigger: When listing practice areas and services on an inner page
taste.decision: Chose full-width rows separated by a 1px rule, title in the left half and description from column 7, over a grid of service cards
taste.reason: A legal client compares areas by reading down a list; cards break that into tiles to scan and make each area look like a product
evidence: services page: 1px divider above each row at x=40 to 1400
radius 0, no shadows on all three pages

taste.name: One field colour per page
taste.trigger: When separating sections on interior pages
taste.decision: Chose a single deep green #052824 field for the whole page, with hierarchy from mint #B1F9E1 vs white text, over alternating section backgrounds
taste.reason: Interior pages are for reading; holding one ground lets type do the work and keeps the eye on the content rather than on the transitions
evidence: #052824 covers 66.8-71.2% of surface on every page

taste.name: One family, one heading weight
taste.decision: Chose Brockmann at 500 for every heading with size and -0.02em tracking as the only variables, over weight contrast
taste.reason: Weight changes add noise; a steady weight reads as composed, which suits a firm selling judgement
evidence: one family on all 3 pages (400-436 nodes)
h1 88px, h2 48-64px, h3 24-32px, all weight 500, all -0.02em

taste.name: Short, front-loaded line rises
taste.trigger: When revealing paragraphs and headings on inner pages
taste.decision: Chose a 0.6s rise per split line on cubic-bezier(0.625, 0.05, 0, 1) over long fades or blur
taste.reason: Interior text has to be readable quickly; a short rise acknowledges arrival without making the reader wait
evidence: gsap_split_line spans start at translateY 39.2px and 67.2px
